0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 57:1 , David in prayer fleeing unto God, complains of his dangerous case
Psa 57:7 , He encourages himself to praise God.
not. A golden Psalm. This Psalm is supposed to have been called al tashcheth , or "destroy not," because David thus addressed one of his followers when about to kill Saul in the cave
and michtam , or "golden," because written, or worthy to be written, in gold.
